verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Give the people of Israel this command: Make sure you bring me my offerings at their set times, my food for the gifts made by fire, as a smell that pleases me.
Tell them: This is the gift made by fire that you must bring to the LORD: two one-year-old male lambs with nothing wrong with them, every day, as a regular burnt offering.
Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at sunset.
With each one, bring a grain offering of about one and a half kilograms of fine flour mixed with about one litre of oil from pressed olives.
This is the regular burnt offering that was set up at Mount Sinai, a gift made by fire with a smell that pleases the LORD.
With each lamb, bring a drink offering of about one litre of strong drink. Pour it out to the LORD in the holy place.
Offer the second lamb at sunset, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is a gift made by fire, a smell that pleases the LORD.
On the Sabbath day, offer two one-year-old male lambs with nothing wrong with them, with a grain offering of about three kilograms of fine flour mixed with oil, and its drink offering.
This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
On the first day of every month, bring the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With each bull, bring a grain offering of about four and a half kilograms of fine flour mixed with oil. With the ram, bring about three kilograms of fine flour mixed with oil.
With each lamb, bring about one and a half kilograms of fine flour mixed with oil. This is a burnt offering, a gift made by fire with a smell that pleases the LORD.

Their drink offerings must be about two litres of wine with each bull, about one and a third litres with the ram, and about one litre with each lamb. This is the burnt offering for every month of the year.
Also offer one male goat to the LORD as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
The LORD's Passover is on the fourteenth day of the first month.
On the fifteenth day of that month, a feast begins. For seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.
On the first day, have a holy gathering and do no regular work.
Bring the LORD a gift made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With them bring a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: about four and a half kilograms with each bull and about three kilograms with the ram.
With each of the seven lambs, bring about one and a half kilograms.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering to make you right with God.
Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
Do this every day for seven days. It is food for the gift made by fire, a smell that pleases the LORD. Offer it in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
On the seventh day, have a holy gathering and do no regular work.
On the day of the first harvest, when you bring the LORD an offering of new grain at the Feast of Weeks, have a holy gathering and do no regular work.
Bring a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, as a smell that pleases the LORD.
With them bring a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: about four and a half kilograms with each bull, about three kilograms with the ram,
and about one and a half kilograms with each of the seven lambs.
Also bring one male goat to make you right with God.
Offer these with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Make sure the animals have nothing wrong with them.
